claim.text: Visa rules for international intended parents were tightened, and in November 2015 medical visas related to surrogacy were suspended, effectively excluding foreign clients from accessing commercial surrogacy in India.

elements.text: Visa rules for international intended parents were tightened
In November 2015 medical visas related to surrogacy were suspended
Foreign clients were excluded from commercial surrogacy in India

sources.citation: Hibino, Yuri (7 July 2023). The advantages and disadvantages of altruistic and commercial surrogacy in India. Philosophy, Ethics, and Humanities in Medicine 18(1): 8.

Background section: surrogacy-related medical visas suspended in November 2015
Background section: foreigners could no longer visit India for surrogacy
